title: FastAPI Not Returning 200 OK Response
body:
### First Check

- [X] I added a very descriptive title here.
- [X] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it.
- [X] I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search.
- [X] I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information.
- [X] I already read and followed all the tutorial in the docs and didn't find an answer.
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Swagger UI](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc).

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
@thyroid_router.post("/predict", response_model=MILResponseModel)
async def predict(
    query: RequestModel,
    mil_predictor: MILPredictor = Depends(get_mil_predictor),
    config=Depends(get_config),
    logger: Logger = Depends(get_logger),
) -> MILResponseModel:


    logger.info(
        f"Accept request slide_path({query.slide_path}), Thread ID({threading.get_ident()})"
    )

    deepzoom_level = get_deepzoom_level(config["mpp"], OpenSlide(query.slide_path))
    tiler = Tiler(
        config.tile_size,
        config.overlap,
        config.limit_bounds,
        deepzoom_level=deepzoom_level,
        n_workers=config.tile_workers,
        patch_filter=PatchFilter(
            [
                check_small_compressed_format,
            ]
        ),
        logger=logger,
    )
    output_queue: queue.Queue = tiler.do_tile_otsu(query.slide_path)
    tiler.join()
    patches = Patches.from_queue(output_queue)
    logger.info(f"End of tiling N={len(patches)} ")

    logger.debug("Start of slide_level prediction")
    confidences, attention_weights = mil_predictor.predict(patches)
    logger.debug("End of prediction")

    # slide-evel prediction
    logger.debug("Confidence to float")
    confidences = confidences.ravel()
    max_idx = confidences.ravel().argmax()
    slide_level_label: str = BinaryLabels(max_idx).name
    slide_confidence = float(confidences[max_idx])

    logger.debug("Build response model")
    slide = OpenSlide(query.slide_path)
    deepzoom_level: int = get_deepzoom_level(config.mpp, slide)
    slide_result = MILSlideResult(
        confidence=slide_confidence,
        label=slide_level_label,
    )
    response = MILResponseModel.build(
        query=query,
        slide_result=slide_result,
        patches=patches,
        heatmap_scores=attention_weights,
        patch_mpp=config.mpp,
        model_uuid=config.model_uuid,
        model_name=mil_predictor.mil_model.__class__.__name__,
        top_patch_percent=config.top_patch_percent,
    )
    logger.info(
        f"End of request slide_path({query.slide_path}), Thread ID({threading.get_ident()})"
    )

    return response
```


### Description

#### Summary
A FastAPI application running in a Docker container does not return a 200 OK response, even though the process completes without any exceptions. The container logs show no errors, and the API appears to be running, but no successful responses are observed.


#### Symptoms
- No 200 OK response for valid requests.
- API requests sent to the correct port (e.g. 30052) and endpoint.
- The process inside the container completes successfully.
- No exceptions or errors appear in the container logs.

### Operating System

Linux

### Operating System Details

_No response_

### FastAPI Version

0.111.0

### Pydantic Version

2.7.1

### Python Version

Python 3.8.19

### Additional Context

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/730cc6e4-6950-4d50-9565-426a5ce54b25)


Note that "121 INFO, end of tiling N=..." refer to the completion of process above screenshot

answer.body:
Hello @4pygmalion there are some inconsistencies between your code and the attached screen.
What error do you have on client? Are you running the docker container behind a proxy?
Based on the screen, the response is not sent starting at 02:07:22 is it right?
Additional: You are running a blocking not async code in the main loop
